note: Private RV park (formerly RV There Yet Campground) beside Spirit Creek Golf Course in Red Deer County, minutes from Red Deer and Sylvan Lake; gravel pads with fire pits and picnic tables, a playground and a rentable gazebo. RVs must be no more than 20 years old; no tents. Nightly, weekly, monthly and seasonal stays. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 77 full-service 30/50 A sites at C$60 (2 adults; extra adult C$5), phone booking, pull-throughs, showers/laundry/Wi-Fi/store. flags: SEASON CHANGE: stored year_round true (note-derived) is contradicted - the operator posts '2026 Season Closing Date ... will officially close for the 2026 season on October 4'. Written opens 05-01 / closes 10-04: the opening comes from the long-term window 'Available Summer only (May 1 - October 4)' - no nightly opening date is posted; reviewer may prefer to drop opens.

PRICE GATE: C$60 nightly (30 or 50 A full service, 2026 rates, operator page), plus GST if charged (not stated) - passes C$69. No Banff/Canmore/Jasper/Waterton within 40 km (gateways.py: Edmonton 136 km, Calgary 145 km).
PRESENCE: website 200 with posted rates and phone; Google 4.2 stars / 242 reviews. RV Life $$$ (not used as the price indicator).

PHONE: stored 403-314-9577 matches the operator's 'Camp Site' / bookings line - keep. Google lists 403-342-2830, which the operator labels 'Tee Time' (golf). Website stored is the RV page (200) - keep.

LONG-STAY TESTS: (1) nights sold by phone, no application/lease/waitlist mentioned - pass; (2) no standing minimum (long weekends are 3-night stays) - pass; (3) nightly share UNREAD - phone-only booking, no engine to measure; nightly, weekly, monthly ('every 28 days', summer only) and seasonal all marketed, and the rules address long-term campers (lawn furniture tucked away on weeknights, no decks/sheds without approval, 2 vehicles on long-term sites). Imagery cannot settle it: the treed northwest edge holds a denser row of units beside the office buildings; the open pull-through loops look like ordinary RV sites. (4) not a home community - pass; (5) RVs under 20 years old (the rig is a 2023, passes). Reviewer's call on the nightly share.
PIN: stored 52.3426,-113.8762 is inside the RV loops (crosshair between the two circles) - OK. Google's point 52.34309,-113.87087 is ~370 m east at the golf clubhouse.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - confirmed): no lake or river near the pads; only a small golf-course pond east of the loops beyond the course road, and the wooded creek valley to the west behind a tree belt.

ACCESS: the operator says 'The bridge to the north on RR 275 is privately owned. Any camper accessing this bridge will be evicted from the park.' Not a road-condition limit (a route restriction: approach from the south); flagging for the note only - not a drop candidate.
